posts.title: Chic Aesthetics London | Turning the database into an operating system

copy.default:
A database can be worth a lot on paper and still do almost nothing operationally.

The difference is whether the business knows who went quiet, who is due back, who showed intent without booking, and what should happen next.

For Chic Aesthetics London, we treated the database as an operating list rather than storage.

The 222Emails method was simple:

→ identify the dormant opportunity
→ reopen the right conversations
→ make the route to booking clear

That is the distinction I want 222Emails to become known for.

Retention is not owning contact data.

It is having a system that knows what should happen next.
